sources.title: C-Dialect-Options.html
sources.confirmed: GCC recognizes ordinary function names, can replace calls with special code, and can retain useful builtin information even when code still calls the function. Freestanding compilation disables ordinary-name builtin recognition by default.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: MSVC intrinsic/function pragmas for dual ordinary and intrinsic implementations
sources.confirmed: Microsoft documents both intrinsic-only routines and routines with ordinary function implementations, with per-function pragmas or /Oi enabling intrinsic substitution; substitution is permitted rather than guaranteed.
sources.limits: This applies to routines with both function and intrinsic implementations, not intrinsic-only operations; substitution remains optional, floating-point intrinsic forms can differ in exception and errno behavior, and function-value use is a transfer inference rather than an executed test. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: oi-generate-intrinsic-functions.md
sources.confirmed: MSVC /Oi permits substitution of certain ordinary calls with intrinsic forms, can retain a call, and supports an explicit function pragma; floating-point intrinsic forms may differ in exceptions and errno behavior.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: Clang builtin-alias attributes on intrinsic function declarations
sources.confirmed: Clang associates selected ARM and RISC-V intrinsic declarations with compiler builtin identities, including after overload resolution; the mechanism is restricted to the implementation of those target headers.
sources.limits: Clang restricts clang_builtin_alias and the ARM variant to selected target intrinsic headers; the opened documentation does not establish general address-taking support, so Rust would still need an ordinary ABI and a callable implementation for function-value uses, with unoptimized behavior checked separately. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: intrinsic.md
sources.confirmed: The intrinsic pragma identifies known function behavior while permitting an ordinary call; it applies to supported named library functions such as memcpy, strlen, and abs.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: function-c-cpp.md
sources.confirmed: The function pragma forces a normal call for a named intrinsic-capable function; the example switches strlen back to a library call while leaving memset intrinsic.
sources.limits: This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.

sources.title: GCC library builtins with ordinary callable fallbacks
sources.version_or_date: GCC 4.8.2, released 2013-10-16 per opened GCC release table
sources.confirmed: GCC 4.8.2 recognizes ordinary standard library names as builtins and emits a library call when expansion is not performed.
sources.limits: The opened historical manuals establish ordinary-name recognition and library-call fallback for selected C library functions, not addressability of every __builtin_ spelling; applying that architecture to Rust function values is a transfer inference, and no zero-overhead or intrinsic-expansion guarantee at -O0 was established. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C15.json.
